definitions.explanation: An unusual or unexpected event that attracts attention because of its rarity. Often carries a humorous or lighthearted nuance, describing something strange but not necessarily serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{珍事|ちんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Something unusual happened during the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{珍事|ちんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: An unprecedented oddity occurred in the Diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{珍事|ちんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: Passengers were surprised by the unusual incident of a cat being found on the train.

notes:
Composed of {珍|ちん} (rare, curious) and {事|じ} (event, matter). Describes events that stand out for being strange, unexpected, or comically unusual. Often used in news headlines and sports reporting to describe bizarre or memorable moments.

USAGE:
Frequently appears in news, sports commentary, and social media to describe something that doesn't normally happen. It has a lighter tone than ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (incident) — {珍事|ちんじ} implies curiosity and amusement rather than alarm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {珍事|ちんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ — an unusual event occurs
- {珍事|ちんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ — an oddity takes place
- ⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{珍事|ちんじ} — an unprecedented oddity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧ — an unusual occurrence; more colloquial
- {椿事|ちんじ} — extraordinary incident; homophone written with different kanji, slightly more serious tone
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ — incident, case; neutral or serious, no humorous connotation
